description: Make the KST+SRS engine self-calibrating and its evidence noise-robust: FSRS parameter-fitting loop, per-priority retention targets, guess/slip-corrected proficiency, multi-evidence placement, fully specified rating mapper, ability-adjusted edge calibration, and an offline evaluation harness contract.
deviation_notes: Gate satisfied 2026-07-07 (core track completed). Implemented as planned; estimated_tasks was a miscount at creation (plan always contained 23 top-level tasks). Released as kst-srs.v3.1. Decisions self-approved under owner directive; pedagogy ratification of v3.1 constants tracked in the shared tech-debt row. Recency weighting spec landed in the FR-3 task (13.1) rather than the FR-5 task, as the estimator lives with the evidence math.
